title: Shoulder Strap for String Trimmer – Adjustable Nylon Strap
descriptionHtml:
Trim for longer – without a sore back and shoulders

Carrying the full weight of the trimmer in your arms makes you tired after just a few minutes. Shoulders, neck and back take the hit, and the job takes longer than it should.

Let the harness carry the weight

The adjustable shoulder strap spreads the trimmer's weight across your shoulders and back instead of straining your arms. Set correctly, the tool feels lighter and you can work comfortably much longer.

Features

  • Spreads the weight across shoulders and back
  • Adjustable nylon strap that fits most body types
  • Relieves arms, neck and wrists
  • Fits most string trimmers and brush cutters
  • Sturdy metal hook for quick on and off

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
